prompt: Each time channel "line" sends "TOTE READY", send tugger_a from tugger_bay to line_feed and back to tugger_bay. Do this for the next 4 hours.
why: A message trigger (0043 S10, S11): a run starts when a message arrives. 2.1 has the condition, not the trigger: a mission starts a run when the previous one is done (0041 M6). The bound is stated; the trigger is what stays out.
